title: Constrained Gradient Equilibrium: Approachability under Locally Constrained Adversaries
abstract: arXiv:2610.33985v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Gradient equilibrium (GEQ) is a recent framework in online learning that requires the time-averaged gradients along the learner's trajectory to vanish. We study GEQ when the learner is constrained and ask when such an equilibrium remains achievable in an adversarial environment. We first show that constrained GEQ (CGEQ) can be impossible even under simple and slowly varying constraints, motivating imposing local temporal structure on the adversary. We then develop an approachability framework for CGEQ under locally constrained adversaries, and obtain necessary and sufficient characterizations in the spirit of classical Blackwell approachability. Beyond these theoretical characterizations, we provide an algorithmic principle that converts window-wise no-regret learners into CGEQ algorithms under a local feasibility condition with margin. translated_title: 约束梯度均衡：局部约束对手下的可达性
translated_abstract: 梯度均衡（GEQ）是近期在线学习领域提出的一个框架，要求沿学习者轨迹的时间平均梯度趋近于零。我们研究学习者受约束情形下的GEQ问题，并探讨在对抗性环境中这种均衡何时仍然可以实现。我们首先证明了约束梯度均衡（CGEQ）即使在简单且缓慢变化的约束下也可能无法实现，这一结果促使我们对对手施加局部时间结构上的限制。随后，我们针对局部约束对手下的CGEQ建立了一个可达性框架，并以经典Blackwell可达性的思想为基础，获得了充要条件的刻画。除这些理论刻画外，我们还提出了一种算法原则，在带裕量的局部可行性条件下，能够将逐窗口的无遗憾学习器转换为CGEQ算法。在合成数据与真实数据上的实验表明，由此得到的算法表现出色。
tldr: 该论文研究了带约束的梯度均衡问题，证明了其在简单约束下可能不可实现，进而针对局部约束对手建立了基于Blackwell可达性思想的充要刻画框架，并提出了在带裕量局部可行性条件下将无遗憾学习器转换为CGEQ算法的通用原则。
en_tdlr: This paper studies constrained gradient equilibrium (CGEQ), shows it can be impossible even under simple slowly varying constraints, establishes a Blackwell-style approachability framework with necessary and sufficient characterizations under locally constrained adversaries, and provides an algorithmic principle that converts window-wise no-regret learners into CGEQ algorithms under a local feasibility condition with margin.
